title: 4.4 ounce egg coddler
text: 4.4 ounce egg coddler. I have tried many different coddlers and this particular design is THE best.  The heavy clear glass (super easy to see what you're coddling), the stainless clasp- doesn't snap and break like the silicone straps of others. Also it's WAY easier to open without making a mess when you want to get into whatever you've coddled.  This size, the 4.4 oz easily holds 2 eggs - even with a onion or mushrooms or chopped spinach added at the bottom or top. Everything dishwasher safe.  The only thing is they are very hard to find this particular design/manufacturer.  I waited weeks to get this one - came from out of the country somewhere.  It's truly worth the extra money.  Just put your patient pants on, they're worth the wait.  Having said all of that,  I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
